title: Great Containers
text: Great Containers. I use these containers to store my loose tea and tea sugar...they are wonderful!  They keep everything airtight and safe from spoilage.  The design is nice and definitely works as described.  I highly recommend this product!

product_metadata.title: STAINLESS STEEL CONTAINERS – Airtight Stainless Food Containers – Leakproof Lids with Silicone Gasket Maintains your Leftover Quality - Perfect for use in Lunch Boxes 3 Pack Set
features: KEEP YOUR FOOD FRESHER LONGER – Air-tight sealing lids make sure that your tasty food stays tasty. Say you’ve just made some delicious pulled pork. What’s worse than it turning into fridge-leather? Nothing! Don’t let it happen!
NO LEAKS OR BROKEN CONTAINERS – Forget fretting about somebody dropping that glass container and shattering it. Gone is the worry about containers getting knocked over, these won’t leak!
BE PROACTIVE ABOUT PRESERVATION – Preserve your food properly so you can continue to experience your food the way it was meant to be experienced!

JUST SAY NO TO OXIDATION – The inert polyethylene shell of the lid is combined with a silicone seal for ultimate seal. The Stainless Steel (18/8 aka 304) used in leaves your flavors unchanged with certainty, unlike plastic containers.

AWESOME CONTAINERS FOR YOUR AWESOME FOOD – Get the best in food storage. Avoid other cheaper containers that won’t treat your food right. You cook like a chef, so store in containers worthy of a chef!
